_comment: HTML JR library manifest. Drop your .html / .svg files into /library and add an entry here. Fields: id, title, type(html|svg), src, desc, seller, price, rating, tags[], thumb(optional image), featured(bool), origin(optional). src can be a repo-relative path OR any url (github blob/raw links auto-render via githack).

listings.title: NEON RAIN
listings.desc: digital downpour. pure canvas, zero dependencies — proof of full JS execution.

listings.title: SYNTH GRID
listings.desc: an infinite outrun horizon that tracks your cursor. CSS + a little JS.

listings.title: JR://TERMINAL
listings.desc: a fake shell that talks back. type `help`. proves keyboard + DOM interactivity.

listings.title: REACTOR ORB
listings.desc: a humming animated core. pure SVG with SMIL + CSS animation.

listings.title: PAINTBOX
listings.desc: a tiny drawing surface. drag to paint — proves pointer events run live.
